author: Or8
body:
Hi, I was banned a few months ago, now that Iron isn't staff I was wondering if I could possibly be unbanned, if so :

 I was banned by Iron with a video recorded with more than 400ms, I don't see that as valid evidence and the staff members Ik say that it looks legit except a moshpit fight(I play with 160 sensitivity) you will understand if you check my previous appeal, also I specifically asked for any one related to Apollo NOT to touch my appeal, yet Iron came in and denied it, I requested an ss and a log file check, they said I couldve easily changed my log files, I told them that files show you when last edited than they didn't reply to that, Im requesting an ss, I also appreciate AGAIN for any one Apollo related to NOT touch this appeal. 

here's some gameplay: https://youtu.be/UDW1g-WwW0g


extra : Apollo is getting way out of hand, and people think they are non toxic players, you should see them on other servers, also so you think it's smart to give basically full control of the server to 1 team, your old staff member Zeusy came in ts and threatened to tell a staff from Apollo to kick me, he also called ma autistic after I asked him to stop messaging me, I wish I had evidence for that.... Also one of the things I was accused of was anti kb, this is the one thing that blows my mind, I've reported JustBudha several times for anti kb and staff didn't even care (Apollo staff was "on it")  not that someone hacking justifies me hacking, it definitely doesn't, all I ask for is some common fucking sense

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

After looking at your previous appeal again and reading through the points presented, I'm still convinced that you were using a hacked client. If you'd like the reasoning for why I think this, look at the points made by Iron & Zeusy in your last appeal. Yes, I am an apollo staff member as well, but escalating an appeal means that any senior can deal with it. Users don't have the obligation to direct it to a specific member, unless the seniors agree on it.

Tied in with all of this, your maturity overall was poor. You started arguments, constantly kept bashing apollo members and using "apollo bias" as a reason to argue, overall immaturity.

You may next create an appeal regarding this situation in 4-6 months as it is currently denied.

Regards,
Fouled
